answer: shale is the lone anchor binding key, host measurement and first judged output, so each forge, one clone, collides there. Entry is custodial hardware proof: the kth forge must keep one measured enclave online through k sequential challenge epochs, sealing epoch i only after burning i tundra to that key; clones cannot rent the same measurement or split a chain. n forge need n(n+1)/2 serial epochs, n distinct hosts and about n^3/6 tundra. It fails if shale accepts replays, enclaves share hosts, or tundra moves.
